title: setup hook --scope user on a user file that is not JSON fails (exit 3) naming ~/.claude/settings.json and writes nothing
source: intended: docs/decisions.md v0.2 row (setup hook --scope user, plan 2.4): the guard registered in ~/.claude/settings.json for the owner's own session, same rules as project scope
intent: INTENDED behavior (plan 2.4, same refusal as project scope). A `~/.claude/settings.json` that is not valid JSON is never edited: exit 3, the message names `~/.claude/settings.json`, the file keeps its bytes.
